attachments.origin_landmark: adductor part: inferior pubic ramus + ischial ramus; hamstring (ischiocondylar) part: ischial tuberosity
attachments.insertion_landmark: adductor part: linea aspera (broad linear insertion); hamstring part: adductor tubercle (via a distinct tendon, with a hiatus for the femoral vessels between the two)

functional_compartments.name: Adductor part
functional_compartments.function_note: Embryologically/functionally an adductor-group muscle, obturator-nerve innervated.
functional_compartments.source: Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset; Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell)

functional_compartments.name: Hamstring (ischiocondylar) part
functional_compartments.function_note: Functionally behaves as a 4th hamstring (hip extensor), sciatic-nerve innervated -- the textbook example of a single named muscle with two developmentally/functionally distinct, separately-innervated compartments.
functional_compartments.source: Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset; Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell)
